d: As the Forward Deployed Engineer – AI at Arabic.AI, you will be the senior engineer embedded with our enterprise and government clients across the region, turning their real business problems into AI solutions that run in production. This is a multi-role position: you will lead discovery and requirements analysis with client stakeholders, translate business needs into scoped AI solutions with clear success criteria, and personally build them using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents and model integration on the client’s data and systems. You will evaluate and harden these solutions, take them from proof of concept to go-live, and drive adoption with client users. Acting as the bridge between client stakeholders and our Product and Engineering teams, you will align technical and product teams on client priorities and feed recurring patterns and field insights back into the product. The role is accountable for the full delivery outcome, from discovery to production and adoption, and for building long-term client trust in Arabic.AI’s solutions.
q: Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders to understand their workflows, data and the real business problem.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into scoped AI solutions with clear success criteria.
Present solution options, trade-offs and progress to client executives and technical teams.
Design and build LLM-based solutions, including RAG, agents, tool calling and model integration, on client data and systems.
Integrate AI solutions with client systems through APIs and data pipelines, in cloud or on-premise environments.
Take proofs of concept and pilots through to production go-live.
Build evaluation frameworks and test sets to measure the accuracy, reliability and safety of AI outputs.
Monitor deployed solutions, troubleshoot failures, and improve prompts, retrieval and model choices.
Apply client data privacy, security and confidentiality requirements, especially for government entities.
Own delivery end to end, from discovery to go-live and adoption.
Drive user onboarding and training so solutions are adopted in daily work.
Track and report delivery KPIs such as adoption, solution accuracy, time to production and client satisfaction.
Act as the bridge between client stakeholders and Product and Engineering teams, and align them on client-driven priorities.
Feed recurring patterns, feature requests and field insights back to Product.
Build reusable components and delivery playbooks for future deployments.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering or technical consulting, including client-facing roles.
Proven experience deploying AI/LLM solutions in production (RAG, agents, model integration).
Experience in business analysis and requirements gathering with enterprise or government clients.
Experience working across product and engineering teams to deliver client solutions.
Strong Python skills; TypeScript is a plus.
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and frameworks, prompt engineering, vector databases and AI evaluation.
Solid experience with APIs, data pipelines and system integration.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
Strong communication skills and confidence presenting to client executives.
Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong plus.
Open to on-site or hybrid work across MENA, with regular travel to client sites.

Certification in at least one of the following is preferred: AI: Claude Certified Developer / Architect (Anthropic) or OpenAI certifications, Cloud: AWS, Azure or GCP at Professional / Architect level, Data & AI platform certifications.

d: AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

As a Rare Disease leader in the market, we are seeking a Rare Diseases Regional Account Partner to join our Commercial Team in Gulf (Oman). This is a full-time field force role, responsible for promoting our products and generating clinically driven demand for our brands across key accounts. The RAP will proactively identify business opportunities, recommend solutions to grow and develop the business, and build strong commercial relationships with opinion leaders and other key stakeholders.

The RAP serves the region as an expert in their therapeutic area, product portfolio, and territory, and works very closely with the Regional Business Manager / Franchise Head to deploy and adapt the AZ account management strategy to the local market, including execution of tactics and account plans. The Regional Account Partner reports directly to the Regional Business Manager and will work closely with the cross-functional team to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to account management and patient access.

The Regional Account Partner will be responsible for promoting Rare Disease medicines with healthcare professionals (HCPs), identifying new patients and patients-on-therapy opportunities, presenting compelling value propositions, and recommending patient-centric solutions. Beyond the typical promotional focus on prescribers and treaters, this role will place strong emphasis on the patient journey, engaging referral specialties to enhance diagnosis, referral pathways, and timely identification of eligible patients. The RAP will also work closely with Market Access to help ensure treatment accessibility and support patients in accessing life-changing medicines.

In doing so, this role will develop strategic and mutually beneficial relationships with healthcare professionals, Key External Experts (KEEs), and other stakeholders, grounded in a deep scientific understanding of the rare disease area and AZ’s therapeutic solutions, in order to identify the best opportunities for the assigned portfolio and deliver meaningful outcomes for patients
r: Customer facing management: Establish and sustain high-value relationships with key decision-makers across rare disease expert centres and disease-specific key accounts; act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders.
Territory & Account Management: identifying priority accounts with proper customers segmentation.
Account planning: Develop insight-based account plans for all top accounts and treatment centres in the respective specialty; represent the territory in regular reviews and account plan discussions.
Driving revenues & sales performance: Execute territory plans to maximize ROI .

Cross-functional execution: Lead development and implementation of customer-focused and patient-centred tactics developed in collaboration with Marketing, Medical, Market Access, and Patient Advocacy, supporting HCP education and patient-oriented solutions across targeted specialties.

Organizational and pathway insights: Build an in-depth understanding of key account structures and regional patient pathways (including referral networks and diagnostic flows) to support disease awareness, timely diagnosis, safe and effective use of our medicines, and patient journeys across all targeted diseases.

Scientific engagement: Create value for HCPs by discussing the latest, in-label scientific data using approved promotional elements; organize hospital promotional meetings and regional education/speaker sessions in line with SOPs and local regulations.

Access & Reimbursement and Tender management: Work proactively and collaboratively with Market Access teams to accelerate and streamline patient funding, formulary listing, tender process to ensure products availability, when public tenders arise in the territory, collaborate closely with the Key Hospital Account Manager.

Compliance and ethics: Always act ethically per the policies and local regulatory frameworks, collect and communicate pharmacovigilance information according to AZ procedures; ensure appropriate utilization for patients receiving AZ medicines, where required.
CRM and reporting: Ensure timely, accurate input of relevant information into CRM systems; deliver complete reporting and presentation of account plans, including KPIs, to leadership.
For Internal candidates: Minimum 1 year experience in the current role.
For External Candidates: Minimum 2 years of experience in Speciality Care.
Bachelor’s degree in pharmaceutical science or relevant medical field.
Able to travel 30% of time (across Oman and/or in Gulf region)
Demonstrated ability to identify diagnostic, referral, access, and treatment gaps and translate findings into actionable strategic initiatives.
Deep understanding of referral-driven care models, diagnostic delays, and stakeholder interdependencies.

Proven experience to work with Market Access teams to accelerate and streamline patient funding, formulary listing, tender process to ensure products availability, when public tenders arise in the territory, collaborate closely with the Key Hospital Account Manager.

Proven track record for delivering consistent, ‘top-tier’ sales results and ability to Orchestrate the full cross functional efforts within assigned territory, leads high-quality conversations both internally and externally.
Strong influencing skills to engage key stakeholders in complex clinical environments, e.g., mid, and senior-level specialty care professionals, key accounts in the medical community
Strong capability to generate actionable insights and continuously integrate account-level stakeholder feedback into cross-functional team (CFT) strategy
Experience in Rare Disease Therapy Area
